executionArgs.additionalInstruction: MagicCarRepair .NET API. JWT ONLY from login response.json()['data']['token'] — NEVER accessToken or root-level token. Users.Id is NOT Customers.Id. Customer POST: identityNo (11 chars), firstName, lastName, email, phoneNumber, dateTimeOfBirth, language — use uuid in identityNo/email to avoid duplicates. Work order status: PUT /api/WorkOrders/{id}/status body {"newStatus":5,"description":"..."}. Invoice: POST /api/Invoices/from-workorder/{workOrderId}. Dashboard charts: GET /api/Dashboard/income-expense-chart, /api/Dashboard/weekly-revenue, /api/Dashboard/today-revenue — NOT GET /api/Dashboard alone. Accounting: /api/accounting-reports/cash-flow, income, expense. Portal: POST /api/Auth/register-customer then login; GET /api/customer-portal/profile. Manager RBAC: login manager@magiccar.com / Manager123! POST /api/Auth/impersonate expect 403. TC032: GET /api/Customers/99999999 expect 404. TC036: POST /api/Sync/data {"changes":[]} accept 200 or 400. TC037: GET /api/client-portal/profile no auth expect 401. requests timeout=120.
